messages:
Nick P.: Hey infra — starting af-south2 cluster bring-up. Primary goals: GPU nodepools, image registry seed, GitOps repo sync. Who's on call for registry seed?
Maria G.: I can own registry seed. Do we have quota for nvidia A100s in af-south2? last check showed 0.
Rahul S.: Filed quota request 2h ago — ticket INFRA-8421. ETA 48-72h unless expedite. ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-8421 created by Rahul S. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-8421 :white_check_mark:
Nick P.: Ok, assume quota delay. Can we start preparing GitOps/helm pipelines, and image replication scripts so they're ready once quota's green?
Jen L.: I'll template helm releases now. Reminder: nodepool taints need `nvidia.com/gpu: "true"` and tolerations for runtime. Adding to helm values.
Maria G.: For registry seeding, we should use signed images only. We'll mirror from staging to a regional mirror & verify with cosign.
Rahul S.: Cosign verify snippet:
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign staging.redwood/app:sha256-abc123
```
Maria G.: And seed command (skopeo):
```
for img in $(cat af-south2-seed.txt); do 
  skopeo copy docker://$img docker://mirror.af-south2.redwood/$img --dest-creds $MIRROR_CREDS
done
```
Nick P.: Good. What about pull-through cache and egress? af-south2 egress to us-west1 costs were flagged in last runbook.
Rahul S.: We'll enable signed image caching in mirror, but initial synchronization will pull ~1.2TB. Cost estimate: ~$150-200 one-time egress + storage. Add to the ticket INFRA-8421 as cost note.
Maria G.: Also need to whitelist cluster CIDRs in mirror GCS bucket and NAT gateway routes. I'll add the firewall rules to the terraform PR.
Jen L.: Helm chart PR: https://git.redwood/infra/region-charts/pull/12 — adds gpu-nodepool values + tolerations. Please review.
Nick P.: Can someone run a dry-run of GitOps apply against a sandbox cluster? Would like to spot templating issues before quota
Ops-bot: Deploy preview created: preview-afs-001 — lint OK, helm diff shows 3 changes.
Maria G.: Running dry-run now, will post any errors. If none, I'll start seeding images next window.
Rahul S.: If quota delayed beyond 72h, fallback plan: use burst nodes in us-west as dedicated forwarding via smart-routing. Will document in runbook.
Jen L.: Heads up: ensure KMS key usage for cosign verification is allowed in af-south2 KMS policy, else verification fails.
Nick P.: Perfect. Plan: Maria seeds + verify after helm dry-run passes. Rahul monitors quota & cost. Jen finalizes helm PR. Handoff to oncall when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
Maria G.: Accepted. I'll ping here when seed complete.
Ops-bot: Reminder — add 'region-hand-off' label to INFRA-8421 when ready.
